metadata.title: Trusted Data
metadata.remarks: Trusted Data is a composite pattern asserting that institutional data is appropriately defined, classified, protected, governed, and retained in accordance with institutional, legal, regulatory, and contractual obligations. This pattern introduces no independent controls. A system may claim trusted-data only when all constituent data protection patterns are realized and assessed.

components.title: Data Core
components.description: Definition of institutional data, ownership, stewardship, and scope.

components.title: Data Classification
components.description: Assignment of sensitivity levels and associated data protection obligations.

components.title: Data Handling and Use
components.description: Policy constraints governing how data may be accessed, processed, shared, and used.

components.title: Data Encryption
components.description: Cryptographic protection of institutional data at rest, in transit, and in use.

components.title: Key Management
components.description: Lifecycle governance of cryptographic keys supporting data protection.

components.title: Public Key Infrastructure
components.description: Certificate-based trust, validation, and revocation for cryptographic identity.

components.title: Data Loss Prevention
components.description: Detection and prevention of unauthorized disclosure or exfiltration of data.

components.title: Records and Retention
components.description: Legal, regulatory, and institutional record retention and disposition controls.
